name: Regional Australia Bank

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Regional Australia Bank — Home Loan Target Market Determination, v1.1, effective 03.11.2025
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: Derived from the key-attributes table row "Minimum Deposit (no LMI) — 20%". The TMD does not state a maximum LVR directly.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Regional Australia Bank — Home Loan Target Market Determination, v1.1, effective 03.11.2025
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Derived from "Minimum Deposit (with LMI) — 5%". The same product covers owner-occupier and investor borrow purposes and the TMD does not distinguish the two, so the investment ceiling is unknown. The public rate card also shows a rate band for "LVR more than 90%".

notes.value: Published rate tiers on the Regional Australia Bank Home Loan product page are: LVR 60% or less, 70% or less, 80% or less, 90% or less, and more than 90% (and equivalently below 60% / 60-70% / 70-80% / 80-90% / more than 90%).
notes.sourceTitle: Regional Australia Bank Home Loan — product and rates page
notes.note: Page carries no publication date; as-at recorded as the date it was read.

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Regional Australia Bank — Home Loan Target Market Determination, v1.1, effective 03.11.2025
minLoanAmount.note: The TMD key-attributes table states "Minimum Amount — $500". This is far below a normal home-loan minimum and is outside the plausible range for this field; it is recorded verbatim rather than adjusted. For comparison, the Basic Home Loan TMD (TMD_HL001, v3.0 eff 22.05.2024) states a Minimum Amount of $100,000, and the Partnership Advantage TMD (TMD_HL002) also states $500.

governmentSchemesSupported.sourceTitle: Regional Australia Bank — Home Loan Target Market Determination, v1.1, effective 03.11.2025

notes.value: Broker distribution is confirmed by the product TMD: "Regional Australia Bank will distribute this product via the following channels: our website, phone, branch, off-site (mobile lenders), mortgage broker (accredited and authorised)." Distribution is restricted to "appropriately authorised staff and/or mortgage brokers". Regional Australia Bank has no public broker/introducer website; accreditation appears to be arranged directly.
notes.sourceTitle: Regional Australia Bank — Home Loan Target Market Determination, v1.1, effective 03.11.2025, s6 Product distribution

gaps: Regional Australia Bank publishes no broker/introducer website and no credit policy guide. Everything here comes from public Target Market Determinations and product pages.
No published assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis or credit-card assessment rate.
No published income, employment tenure, credit history, security or residency policy.
The $500 'Minimum Amount' in the Home Loan TMD is implausible for a mortgage and needs broker confirmation; the Basic Home Loan TMD says $100,000.
No separate investment maximum LVR published.

Regional Australia Bank merged with Summerland Bank on 1 July 2026; Summerland Bank now trades as a brand of Regional Australia Bank Ltd and is recorded separately as 'summerland-bank'. Systems were not yet integrated as at that date, so the two brands may still run different policy.
